scope: In-progress ME5 fossil Item forms, named evolution and Fossil Quarry. Evidence is not a declaration of completed card support.

ruleReferences.facts: Antique Armor Fossil: Item playable as a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokemon; no Special Conditions or retreat; optional own-turn discard from play. Separate Protective Armor Ability requires the source Active and reduces opponent attack damage to all own Pokemon by 10 after Weakness and Resistance.

Antique Skull Fossil has the same printed Item-form rules. Separate Spiny Skull Ability places 3 damage counters on the attacking Pokemon when the Active source is damaged by an opponent's attack, including lethal damage.
Fossil Quarry: once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for up to 2 Item cards with Antique in their names and put them onto their Bench, then shuffle.
Antique Cover Fossil cannot be placed during setup and remains an Item in hand/discard; ordinary Pokemon-only placement or recovery does not select it.
Antique Dome Fossil cannot be selected by Nest Ball. Its Item play differs from playing a Basic Pokemon card from hand; in play it is a Pokemon eligible for correctly named evolution.
